aliases: Luckett Road North and South Data Centers

No site-plan approval, building permit, construction start, energization, tenant/operator identity, or full buildout evidence was verified.

Capacity_mw remains null because public sources give estimated electric demand by parcel, not verified IT critical load.

contradictions.details: Prior alias 'Project Blue Marana' conflated the Marana Luckett Road Data Center with Beale's separate Project Blue/Pima County campus near the Pima County Fairgrounds. Official Town of Marana and Beale pages identify this Marana record as Luckett Road North/South or Luckett Road Data Center; Pima County records identify Project Blue separately as a 290-acre unincorporated Pima County project west of Houghton Road and north of the fairgrounds.

Town and regional sources publish estimated electrical demand of 550-750 MW per Luckett Road parcel, while the data model's capacity_mw scalar is retained as null because that range is not verified IT critical load or energized capacity.
